nodes.title: Brain's ofCard (BoardSegment, v6.2 T46) reaches the client on the composed whiteboard script: page 0 as script.ofCard (from intent.ofCard) and each later page as switches[k].ofCard (from intent.segments[k].ofCard). Studio's patch to-studio/002 does the carrying in normalizeScript, segmentsOf/pagesBoard and seam drawn(). App's reader (boardPage.ts boardOnTray) already reads that shape. Brain confirmed that a paged turn's new card is its last page (3a holds). Reverse: Studio sends the flags elsewhere on the artifact.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-ofcard-wire`
The flag that tells the card to wait travels on the board itself, page by page, so the phone needs nothing else from the turn.
